sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.196/2022, registered at Police Station-Rehti,
District-Sehore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 31.01.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Applicant is a young man aged about 23 years and prosecutrix is aged about 16 years.
Applicant and prosecutrix were having love affair with each other.
Charge sheet has been filed and investigation is complete.

In view of same,
applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
Prosecutrix is minor and her consent is immaterial, therefore, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.

In view of aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that applicant is in jail since 31.01.2023 and trial will take considerable time for its conclusion, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.
